items.text: On August 9, the United States Forest Service and the Wartime Advertising Council released posters featuring Smokey Bear for the first time.
items.question: Where do you remember first seeing Smokey Bear, and who was with you?

items.text: On October 8, The Adventures of Ozzie and Harriet radio show debuted.
items.question: Who in your house listened to Ozzie and Harriet on the radio, and where did everyone sit?
items.source_quote: October 8 – The Adventures of Ozzie and Harriet radio show debuts in the United States.

items.text: The St. Louis Cardinals beat the St. Louis Browns, 4 games to 2, in the only all St. Louis World Series.
items.question: Who in your family followed the all St. Louis World Series, and which team were they for?
items.source_quote: The St. Louis Cardinals defeat the St. Louis Browns, 4 games to 2, to win their 5th World Series Title. This is the only all St. Louis World Series.
